name: segment
description: TypeSafe Jev question definitions and truth-table rules for detecting topic boundaries across OpenAI-style conversation turns.

state_contract.current_segment: List of contiguous OpenAI-style message dicts ([{"role": "user"|"assistant", "content": "..."}]) representing the active topic thread so far.
state_contract.candidate_message: The next message dict ({"role": "user"|"assistant", "content": "..."}) being evaluated at the boundary.

continues_topic.instructions: Does `candidate_message` continue, answer, clarify, or follow up on the subject discussed in `current_segment`?

criteria.true: `candidate_message` replies to, troubleshoots, refines, confirms, or closes out the same technical issue, question, or task active in `current_segment`.
criteria.false: `candidate_message` drops the subject in `current_segment` without addressing or referencing it, or is pure standalone conversational filler.

introduces_new_topic.instructions: Does `candidate_message` introduce a new, unrelated subject or separate task that was not part of `current_segment`?

criteria.true: `candidate_message` shifts the conversation to a different system, component, feature request, or unrelated problem from the one in `current_segment`.
criteria.false: `candidate_message` stays within the scope of the existing subject in `current_segment`, or is a brief acknowledgment with no new subject.
